description: ESD-side DAE binding-contract fixtures per discretization RFC §12. Each fixture is an ESM document that, after ESD routes through EarthSciSerialization.discretize(), contains algebraic equation(s) alongside differential equation(s). Bindings MUST either (a) accept the DAE and return a discretized document whose metadata.system_class is "dae", or (b) abort with error code E_NO_DAE_SUPPORT when DAE support is disabled. Silent success with system_class absent or equal to "ode" is a test failure.

fixtures.description: One differential equation (dx/dt = -k*x) plus one algebraic observed equation (y = x^2). dae_support=true: metadata.system_class == "dae", dae_info.algebraic_equation_count == 1. dae_support=false: abort with E_NO_DAE_SUPPORT.
Baseline: same scalar ODE with no algebraic constraint. Output metadata.system_class == "ode"; E_NO_DAE_SUPPORT is NOT emitted under dae_support=false.

note: RFC §12 requires Julia and Rust to implement both the DAE-success path (metadata.system_class == "dae") and the disabled-DAE path (E_NO_DAE_SUPPORT). Python, Go, and TypeScript MAY stub the success path in v0.2.0 but MUST emit the exact error code on the failure path.
